how: An invitation asks people to help a saltire already in progress rather than recording its first placement.
A late invitation offers entry into an existing contribution rather than demonstrating that it begins the reported work.
A dismissive question about the call receives a cooperation explanation followed by an image example.
The question is answered by an explanation and then an example, without demonstrating acceptance of the call.
A request for help with an existing work does not establish a judgement of insufficient hands or space.
A departure and addictive involvement do not establish withdrawal under strain or repair of a quarrel.
A saltire is put forward as a work for people to help.
A member offers an alternative drawing without any recorded adoption of that proposal.
The alternative proposer fits the minimal starter role without evidence of placing or others joining.
The first work is already progressing and the alternative comes later, leaving a starter-to-call sequence unestablished.
A member's alternative cannot establish a collectively adopted design without uptake or agreement.
The invitation reports a contribution progressing rather than documenting its construction turn by turn.
An anchor coordinate locates the existing work.
The invitation supplies coordinates for the contribution it describes.
A posted chat link instantiates routing at its smallest range without revealing decisions or participation inside the server.
An explanatory example image is not evidence that a design debate ended with an agreed pixel template.
A report posted after an invitation cannot establish invitation-caused labour when the activity is explicitly retrospective.
The coordination links do not report bots, scripts or spare accounts.
The coordination passages report neither site faults nor fixes.
A public chat invitation does not establish concealment or spying.
The public reports disclose no decided order but cannot reveal unseen chat organization or test the cross-room prevalence claim.
A keeper reports days of watching and removing stray coloured flecks without identifying an agreed redesign being repaired away.
An outgoing keeper ends a personal watch and urges others to continue without demonstrating an accepted replacement or scheduled shifts.
Repair presupposes placed pixels but the report does not establish a transition from initial building to keeping.
The keeper describes changed pixels without identifying who placed them or why.
The upkeep report contains no transition from strain to automated placements.
A participant reports a truce without disclosing its terms, negotiation or enforcement.
Repair and a truce appear in one report without establishing that erosion caused negotiation.
The truce report does not describe sparing neighbours, restraining attackers or apologising.
An agreement is reported without evidence that it produced restraint toward the neighbour.
An invitation reports help from a kindred community without specifying a bargain.
Reported outside help does not establish a coalition or reciprocal defence agreement.
The report of outside help does not establish upkeep strain causing a cross-room appeal.
Neither outside help nor upkeep reports establish shared threat causing a defence coalition.
A truce report supplies no subsequent exchange of help through its channel.
No participant is shown carrying a proposal between the communities.
Help and a truce do not establish a guest work subject to another room's territorial rule.
The truce report neither disputes authority nor states the limits of who may bind placers.
The reported agreement has no recorded refusal or stated limit on compliance.
Two coordinates without established work continuity do not reveal initial site choice or pre-loss adjustment.
The record does not establish that the differently located contributions are one work relocated after loss.
Different coordinates establish neither scarcity nor a scarcity-caused move.
Reported national help and a truce do not establish a participant declaring dual allegiance.
Explaining cooperation and proposing a crude drawing do not constitute a dispute over whether covering work is fair.
Neither the national invitation nor the generic alternative names an inherited quarrel.
National representation alone does not establish politics, lore or ideology beyond the flag.
The alternative names no rival or inherited tie through which an attack target could be explained.
The bridge pun concerns civic works and the crude alternative has no recorded uptake as a canvas joke.
Profanity and a crude proposal do not show participants arguing over offence or rejecting hate symbols.
A chat link does not establish formation of a new room around a mark.
Civic tunnel and bridge jokes receive teasing, explicit April Fools praise and a new bridge name independently of the canvas effort.
A dismissive question followed by explanation is insufficient evidence that members are drawing a boundary around canvas talk.
The coded exchanges do not show a posting boundary, moderation rule or objection to a flood.
Calls are recorded without evidence of flooding or containment caused by it.
Confusion and an alternative proposal do not show members sabotaging their own mark because of canvas posts.
Members acknowledge present progress and their own labour before the close without announcing final completion.
A contemporary image link accompanies the invitation without establishing a final archive.
Members report five hours of addictive involvement and departure ending a watch.
Positive progress reports do not establish a completed mark causing a completion ritual.
An image attached to an invitation does not show celebration causing preservation.
Encouraging present work is not a recorded plan to carry the effort beyond this canvas.
The cited pre-close reports do not show a later dispute over a preserved canvas or historical account.
A contemporary image link and encouragement supply no preservation-to-continuation sequence.
An invitation to participate does not report newcomers arriving in the sub through its work.
The image-bearing invitation is not addressed to creators, a team, a company or the press.
The crude drawing proposal reaches only suggested prank alteration, not a named target or executed attack.
A suggested alteration cannot establish a room-level raid or an executed attack without target or action evidence.
A crude alternative replying to a call does not establish that the call recruited attackers or produced an attack.
The generic alternative does not name a rival or supply an exchange of taunts.
The coded alternative has no recorded reply refusing an attack or explaining restraint.
A separate truce report does not show the alternative attack proposal being answered with negotiation.
No rival or subsequent contest talk connects the suggested alteration to rivalry.
The question and retrospective watch report do not instantiate a bare one-line acceptance.
A reply to a call can request clarification rather than accept or decline, so adjacency alone cannot classify joining.
